grpc.marshalling: LatticeSchemaGrpcMarshallers.Create delegates to the Orleans serializer.

metadata.name: authorization
metadata.purpose: Credential token header; the default bridge strips the configured Bearer scheme and stamps a LatticeCredential.

metadata.name: active tenant header
metadata.purpose: Configured active tenant assertion header; the assertion is re-validated downstream and grants no access by itself.

metadata.name: lattice-quota-current
metadata.purpose: ResourceExhausted trailer carrying the observed breached value when a numeric ceiling exists.

metadata.name: lattice-quota-dimension
metadata.purpose: ResourceExhausted trailer naming the breached quota dimension.

metadata.name: lattice-quota-limit
metadata.purpose: ResourceExhausted trailer carrying the configured breached ceiling when a numeric ceiling exists.

metadata.name: lattice-quota-tree
metadata.purpose: ResourceExhausted trailer naming the tree whose quota was breached.

auth.decision: Default deny when RequireAuthorization is true; GetAuthScheme is exempt.

requires.name: AddLatticeSchemaEnforcement
requires.reason: The schema facade drives the schema admin surface and fails fast when AddLatticeSchemaEnforcement has not registered it.

fields.name: StrictIngest
fields.notes: When true, intercepted system-origin writes are re-validated and non-compliant items are dead-lettered; replicated typed-CRDT deltas and replicated atomic-batch entries are intercepted, but plain last-writer-wins replication apply, backup restore and tree merge bypass write interception.

fields.name: MaxByteLength
fields.notes: For MaxByteLength encoding rules, a supplied limit must be non-negative.

errors.condition: The tree is unversioned, the target does not advance, or versioning is not registered.

retry.policy: Do not retry blindly after success because the target version must strictly advance.

idempotency.basis: The target is monotonic and the new version must be strictly greater than the current target.

concurrency.rule: New writes are stamped at the new version immediately; existing values are upcast lazily on read.

idempotency.basis: A second cancel request leaves the operation unchanged; a terminal operation is returned unchanged.

concurrency.rule: Reads are scoped fail-closed to the schema.compliance-scan kind, the caller's tenant and trees the caller may read, and return null for invisible operations.

The caller may not manage the tree's schema.
Schema versioning is not registered, or the operation id is in use by an operation of a different kind.
The server's schema control facade does not implement ILatticeSchemaOperations.

retry.policy: Retry with the same caller-supplied operation id; a duplicate start returns the existing handle with Created=false. A fresh start whose target no longer advances fails the operation in its first phase.

idempotency.basis: The optional operationId is the tracked operation idempotency key; reusing it returns the existing operation instead of starting new work.

concurrency.rule: The tree's coordinator records the run and drives it one bounded slice of values at a time from a durable cursor; a cancel takes effect between slices and is declined during cutover. If the silo running the work is lost the operation reads Failed, and starting the same remediation again resumes it from its last slice.

error_taxonomy.meaning: The request or authorization check was cancelled.
A referenced key or target was not found.
The caller is not authorized or cannot act as the asserted tenant.
A remediation or migration rebuild breached a per-tree admission cap.
The server does not serve the requested tracked schema operations: it registered no ILatticeSchemaComplianceOperations, or its schema control facade does not implement ILatticeSchemaOperations.
